status_definitions.verified: A decoder passes one or more supplied vendor or hardware-export fixtures for the named variant.
status_definitions.layout-tested: A decoder passes a deterministic synthetic fixture; obtain a real export before advertising hardware support.
status_definitions.experimental: The route follows published structure but lacks a representative real export from the target software/model.
status_definitions.conversion-required: SignalForge recognises the file but intentionally does not decode it; a vendor-supported export is required.
status_definitions.provisional: Parser source exists, but this bundle contains no fixture proving the variant.
status_definitions.unsupported: The variant must be rejected explicitly rather than partially decoded.
